cards.title: Partner's behavior at kids' football matches straining relationship
cards.body: A parent seeks advice after 25 years together as their partner's obnoxious conduct at their sons' football matches is creating tension. The advice columnist suggests finding a quiet moment to understand where the anger is coming from before making judgments.

cards.title: Why children saying 'Na-na, na-na-na!' feels so annoying
cards.body: Readers explore the psychology behind why repetitive, taunting sounds from children are particularly irritating to adults. The discussion examines the developmental and behavioral reasons kids engage in this type of annoying behavior.

cards.title: Making Halloween magical for your kids this year
cards.body: A parent ditches cynicism to embrace Halloween celebrations as a moment of genuine magic and connection with their children. Celebrating autumn traditions creates meaningful family experiences beyond the commercial aspects.

cards.title: Helping traumatized children with severe behaviors
cards.body: Strong fears often drive troubling behaviors in children, and there are practical strategies to address them. These parenting tips benefit adoptive, foster, and biological parents navigating challenging behavioral issues.

cards.title: When kids say 'I'm bored,' should you fix it?
cards.body: Parents' instinct is often to eliminate boredom quickly, but discomfort may serve an important developmental purpose. Sometimes the best parenting response is to do nothing and let children sit with boredom.

cards.title: Understanding your partner's attachment style for parenting
cards.body: Knowing your co-parent's attachment style helps prevent misinterpreting their behavior and strengthens your partnership. This understanding is crucial for creating a stable family environment for your children.

cards.title: Teen mental health: looking beyond screens and social media
cards.body: Experts examine what we're getting wrong about kids and technology use in the modern age. The conversation moves beyond surface-level screen time concerns to deeper mental health impacts.
